items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: They had two up there. They had him and they had Joe Walker. You ever heard of Joe Walker?

ctx.x: Ha, ha, ha, ha. I just didn't know anything about him. What did he play? Drum. Was he any good?
Woo! He was the greatest drummer... One of the greatest drummers in the South. They had two up there. They had him and they had Joe Walker. You ever heard of Joe Walker?
I've heard the name, but I can't place him. I'm thinking about a saxophone. And he was a good drummer, Joe Walker, huh?
